## [epiaware.org](https://epiaware.org)

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="55%"}
- Models that synthesise several data streams give better evidence than
  chains of models that hand summaries to each other
- Building one is slow, and needs expertise across several domains
- So we want the components reusable, not the model
- `EpiAware` is the attempt at that in Julia. Packages, docs, and a
  written account of what any approach has to do

::: {.callout-note}
The case for composition is the 16:45 talk in this room.
:::
